content: react-number-format's NumericFormat is the standard controlled-input solution for masked numeric/currency entry in React; integrate via Controller, reading onValueChange's floatValue/formattedValue and forwarding name/onBlur/ref from field. For this project the simpler and stack-consistent choice is a plain shared/ui Input with inputMode="decimal", client Zod/manual regex mirroring the API's AMOUNT_PATTERN, and formatting only on blur/display -- avoids adding a new dependency for a single numeric field and keeps the raw string the source of truth matching the API contract.
